metadata.title: आदिवासी और सरकार के बीच विश्वास का पुल क्यों टूटा | Why Adivasis oppose a bridge which they need
metadata.description:
In 2022, the Chhattisgarh government announced the construction of a bridge over the Kotari river in south Kanker to connect nearly 70 remote villages cut off during the monsoon. But instead of welcoming the project, local Adivasi communities are strongly opposing it.
For them, the river and the surrounding forest are not just geography — they are life, livelihood, and identity. They fear that the bridge will bring outsiders, exploitation, and ultimately the loss of their forest.
In this ground report, Main Bhi Bharat reaches the banks of Kotari to understand the deeper conflict — one not just about infrastructure, but about trust, displacement, and the silence of those who are rarely heard.

Why has the state failed to gain the trust of Adivasis?
Is development possible without dialogue?
Watch this special report from the heart of Bastar.
